Diamond Springs Ranch • Sedgwick, Kansas

Cold drinks. Good company. Real ranch.

The Rusty Saddle Bar is your home base at Diamond Springs Ranch. Open during events and private gatherings.

Book an Event Contact Us
Scroll

The Rusty Saddle is Diamond Springs Ranch’s on-site bar — cash bar, no outside alcohol, and built into the fabric of the property the same way everything else out here is. It’s not a venue amenity. It’s part of what makes a private evening here feel like a private evening on a real Western ranch. There’s a difference, and you feel it.

We built this place for people who want something real. The Rusty Saddle is where that feeling carries into the evening. After a team retreat on the ranch, after a trail ride at sunset, after a celebration that deserved more than a restaurant — it’s the place people end up gathered around without being told to. That’s not accidental. It’s what we were going for.

When Is The Rusty Saddle Open?

The Rusty Saddle opens during ranch events and reserved experiences — not as a standalone walk-in bar. If you’re booking a private event, a corporate retreat, or the Dinner Date Experience, the bar is part of what makes it work. Call (316) 303-6195 to discuss how to include it in your event.

Live Music and Bonfire Nights

We host seasonal live music evenings and bonfire nights at the ranch. The Rusty Saddle is always part of those. They sell out. Follow us on Instagram at @diamondspringsranch and on Facebook so you’re not the last to know.

Private Events Featuring The Rusty Saddle

Corporate retreats, birthday parties, family reunions — bar service can be built into any private event at the ranch. Call (316) 303-6195 and we’ll tell you what that looks like for your group.

Explore more: Private Events & Rentals, Dinner Date Experience. View all ranch experiences.

What Are Common Questions About The Rusty Saddle Bar?

The Rusty Saddle is the on-site bar at Diamond Springs Ranch — available during private events, overnight stays, and dinner date experiences at the ranch.
The Rusty Saddle is not a standalone walk-in bar — it operates as part of ranch experiences and events. For public access, watch for seasonal live music and bonfire night events announced on the ranch’s social media.
Yes. Bar service through The Rusty Saddle is available for corporate events, private parties, and group events. Discuss it when you call (316) 303-6195 to book your event.
Yes — the ranch hosts seasonal live music and bonfire nights. These events include The Rusty Saddle Bar and sell out regularly. Follow @diamondspringsranch on Instagram and Facebook for announcements.
Overnight guests booking the treehouse, covered wagon, or dinner date experience may have access depending on the date and what is operating that evening. Ask when you call to book your stay.
